sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 181
PLD 2023 Punjab Statutes 181
ORDINANCE IV OF 2023
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF THE PUNJAB SECRETARIAT
SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2023
An Ordinance to amend the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
20th April, 2023]
No.
Legis:13-9/2022, dated 20.4.2023.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published
for general information:
It
is expedient to amend the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat
Services Act 2019 (IX of 2019) in the manner hereinafter appearing to remove
the anomaly regarding decision of appeal by the same authority who has passed
the order against any employee of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and to
provide for ancillary matters;
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session due to its dissolution and Governor of
the Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to
take immediate action;
In
exercise of all the powers conferred on him under clause (1) of Article 128 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Ordinance may be cited as the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat
Services (Amendment) Ordinance, 2023.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

SERVICES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2023
An Ordinance to amend the Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
20th April, 2023]
No.
Legis:13-9/2022, dated 20.4.2023.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by Governor of the Punjab is hereby published
for general information:
It
is expedient to amend the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat
Services Act 2019 (IX of 2019) in the manner hereinafter appearing to remove
the anomaly regarding decision of appeal by the same authority who has passed
the order against any employee of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab and to
provide for ancillary matters;
Provincial
Assembly of the Punjab is not in session due to its dissolution and Governor of
the Punjab is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to
take immediate action;
In
exercise of all the powers conferred on him under clause (1) of Article 128 of
the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:
2. Amendment
of section 20 of Act IX of 2019.---In
the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab Secretariat Services Act, 2019 (IX of
2019), in section 20, for subsection (2), the following shall be substituted:
"(2)
Where no provision for appeal exists under the Act and the rules in respect of
any order, an employee aggrieved by any such order, within sixty days of the
communication to him of such order, shall have a right to prefer an appeal
against it before the:
(a) Speaker,
if the order is passed by an authority other than Speaker; and
(b) Governor
of the Punjab, if the order is passed by the Speaker:
Provided
that any employee aggrieved by such order passed after 1st January 2022 shall
also have the right to prefer an appeal under this provision, within sixty days
from the commencement of this Ordinance.".
